{{Top}}
'''Rethen''', sometimes called '''Rethin''', was a type of gas that was found within the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Killaniri]] and [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].

Bespin was composed of rethen in liquid and solid forms.
